about: Qampus aims to solve all the problems that students face and to transform the university experience altogether, starting with the issue of finding cheap textbooks as well as selling the textbooks you no longer need. By using Qampus, you save yourself the trouble of looking for buyers for your textbooks as well as the people to buy textbooks from at an affordable price. Keep an eye out for our upcoming features and let us help you save money while you make new friends on Qampus. For more information about Qampus send us an email on qampus@nuclearsoftware.co.za and we will get back to you as soon as we can.
